issues: Summary presents the high-priesthood teaching as a description of ordination, but no present ordination is narrated; keep it clearly doctrinal rather than depicting an event.

The dialogue excerpts from verses 14–15 are fragmented and not verbatim contiguous quotations: the selected verse text is interrupted by omitted words. Under the quotation rule, use shorter exact excerpts.
A single scene risks conflating the speaker's present appeal with the historical references to Melchizedek and Abraham; neither historical figure's presence nor a tithe-payment scene is established.
The summary's 'later repented' and 'established peace' are source-supported outcomes, but the scene must remain focused on preaching; do not depict those later outcomes simultaneously.
The dialogue paraphrases verse 20, although speech must be quoted verbatim; replace it with contiguous exact excerpts.
The summary says the unidentified man was unnamed, but verse 19 does not establish that he is unnamed; it only uses 'him'.
The spoken dialogue is an incomplete clause ending in a semicolon; use a complete contiguous exact excerpt or a short exact excerpt without altering source punctuation.
The title adds a call to repentance that is only Alma's quoted words, while the summary omits that speech and overemphasizes the gesture.
